summary: Test only: the daemon restart tests stop their API by dropping its runtime, so a request accepted just before the stop can no longer answer from the graph afterwards, as it cannot when a real daemon exits; a test holds a request in its handler through the stop and checks the connection closes without an answer

replay.detail: Test change only; no replay or recovery behavior changes.

schema.detail: No schema or persistent data changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or coordinated upgrade changes.

downtime.detail: No startup work or expected interruption.

manual.detail: No operator actions or configuration changes.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or new swap-back restrictions.
